tweetText: OpenAI shared its approach to partnerships with the government on national security, emphasizing responsible AI use and public safety. This matters because it sets a standard for accountability in AI deployment. via OpenAI News

OpenAI's new analysis shows flaws in SWE-Bench Pro, a widely-used coding benchmark for AI models, questioning its reliability. This matters because accurate evaluations are crucial for the development of trustworthy AI. via OpenAI News

OpenAI Academy and the Walton Family Foundation are launching AI Skills Jams to help K–12 teachers gain practical AI skills. This initiative aims to enhance education by equipping educators with the tools to integrate AI in their classrooms. via OpenAI News

Google's deepfake detector identified a viral fake image of Senator McConnell in distress as an AI-generated hoax. This highlights the importance of tech in combating misinformation. via TechCrunch AI
SpaceXAI launched Grok 4.5, an advanced AI model that’s cheaper and more efficient. This could make powerful AI more accessible and disrupt the market. via TechCrunch AI

A startup called General Intuition is using video game data to train AI models for robotics, aiming to revolutionize how robots learn. This could lead to smarter robots that require less real-world data to function effectively. via TechCrunch AI

Google Photos just launched a new AI 'Video Remix' tool that enhances videos with cinematic relighting and fun backgrounds. This makes it easier for users to create visually stunning video content. via TechCrunch AI

A CEO believes video games could provide better training data for AI than the internet, which may help achieve artificial general intelligence. This shift could enhance AI's ability to understand real-world dynamics. via TechCrunch AI

Meta is introducing new features to prevent its AI glasses from secretly recording people. This is important as it raises concerns about privacy while the company expands its data collection practices. via TechCrunch AI

OpenAI has launched new voice models that can speak and listen simultaneously, enhancing live conversations. This breakthrough is crucial for more natural and effective communication, especially in translation. via TechCrunch AI
